name: Auto-combat
author: OpenDejenol
description: Gives each member's fight order every round by your own rules, through the game's own order keys and Cast.

settings.label: Fight by the rules
settings.description: Each round of a fight, gives every member the order of the first rule that fits.

settings.label: Leave the one in command to me
settings.description: The character in command keeps the orders you give them by hand.
